title: 7.12 Farm and Wild Animals
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Name farm and wild animals and say what they are doing: El caballo está corriendo.
speaking_outcome: Name farm and wild animals and say what they are doing: El caballo está corriendo.
